components.name: EVP_BytesToKey mimic (SHA-512 iterated, AES-256-CBC key/iv layout)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The signature curve of the entire Dogecoin protocol: every transaction signature (ECDSA) and every public-key derivation uses secp256k1, via the vendored libsecp256k1 (3,683 sites across 92 files — library source, headers, benchmarks) plus the node's call sites in src/key.cpp (pubkey create/serialize, seckey verify, DER import/export through OpenSSL, BIP32 tweak_add at key.cpp:241) and the Python test framework. First-party and changeable here in the mechanical sense (the subtree can be swapped)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two sub-assets under one grouping: (a) the scrypt-internal PBKDF2 with c=1 (same asset as ALG-4de3b020 — PoW hash per RFC 7914, not password storage); (b) the wallet passphrase KDF iteration default nDeriveIterations = 25000 (crypter.h:62, wallet.cpp:352/618) feeding CCrypter::BytesToKeySHA512AES — a homegrown EVP_BytesToKey mimic whose 25,000 iterations are far below modern password-KDF guidance; the KDF implementation itself (crypter.cpp:17-50) is reported as a separate finding. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH module of the vendored libsecp256k1 (src/secp256k1/src/modules/ecdh/): the sites are the CI build-matrix toggles (.cirrus.yml ECDH: yes/no) and the module's benchmark wiring (bench.c, modules/ecdh/bench_impl.h). The ECDH code ships in the library source (ECDH over secp256k1), but the Dogecoin node has no application call site for it — presence, not use. Quantum-vulnerable key agreement if ever enabled; replaceable by updating the subtree (ML-KEM-768 when a PQ ECDH module exists). Changeable

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA signatures over secp256k1: qa/rpc-tests/test_framework/key.py signs auxpow hashes with the python `ecdsa` package (used to build valid test blocks in this merged-mining coin), and src/secp256k1/src/bench.c exercises secp256k1_ecdsa_sign/verify (plus the recovery module bench) against the shipped libsecp256k1. Consensus rules fix the algorithm and curve, so this is changeable only via a chain-level fork, not an app-level swap.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Constant-time AES (ctaes, vendored from Bitcoin Core): AES-128 wrapper API in src/crypto/aes.cpp/aes.h over ctaes.c. Exercised by unit tests (crypto_tests.cpp), ctaes self-tests and benchmarks only — the wallet path uses the AES-256 variants. Available in the shipped library; no production call site found in the node.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Unit tests exercising the first-party CHMAC_SHA256 and CHMAC_SHA512 implementations (src/crypto/hmac_sha256.cpp, hmac_sha512.cpp) with the standard RFC 4231 test vectors. Production uses of the same classes do exist in this tree — Tor SAFECOOKIE authentication (torcontrol.cpp:506), the -rpcauth password verifier (httprpc.cpp:119) and BIP32 child-key derivation (hash.cpp:85) — and are reported as separate findings since this object covers only the test sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The scrypt-internal PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (RFC 7914 structure) of Dogecoin's PoW hash: scrypt.cpp/scrypt-sse2.cpp call PBKDF2_SHA256 with c=1 (by scrypt's own spec — the memory-hard N=1024 carries the work factor) on the 80-byte block header as both 'password' and 'salt'. The low-iteration flag is a rule artifact of applying a password-storage minimum to a PoW; the recorded parameters (1 iteration, HMAC-SHA256) are nonetheless accurate. Same logical asset as the low-iterations view ALG-a861135a.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Constant-time AES (ctaes) AES-256 implementation plus the node's live use: CCrypter encrypts/decrypts wallet private keys with AES-256-CBC (crypter.cpp:85,104; PKCS#7 padding, no MAC on the ciphertext — integrity rests on the wallet file checksum). The AES-256-CBC key comes from the wallet passphrase through a homegrown EVP_BytesToKey mimic (SHA-512, 25,000 iterations — see the wallet-KDF finding). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The node's CSPRNG core (src/random.cpp): OS entropy gathered via getrandom/urandom/RdRand, seeded into the RNG pool; gen_base58_test_vectors.py seeds deterministically for reproducible vectors. Symmetric primitive, not Shor-relevant, but it feeds every key and salt the node produces.
